claim: All Brands Furniture, 696 Oak Tree Ave, Piscataway
problem: Wrong town. The store's own contact page lists this location as 696 Oak Tree Ave, South Plainfield NJ 07080. It is also one of four All Brands Furniture stores in NJ (Greenbrook, Perth Amboy, South Plainfield, Lawrenceville), so it is a multi-store chain rather than a one-site independent.
fix: Remove from the Piscataway list (or move to the South Plainfield zone); correct town to South Plainfield if kept.

problem: Wrong town. The company's own location page lists 175 Talmadge Rd as Edison NJ 08817 (warehouse at 44 National Rd, Edison), plus showrooms in Manhattan, Queens and Paramus - a multi-branch furniture retailer.
fix: Remove from Piscataway (Edison zone); correct town to Edison if kept.

claim: Pantagis Renaissance (event venue, address 'Unknown', town Piscataway)
problem: Not a Piscataway business. Pantagis Renaissance was at 250 Park Ave, Scotch Plains NJ 07076, and venue directories mark it closed. The entry appears to have leaked in from the NJ Business Directory page rather than being verified.

claim: Raritan Landing Golf Course, 491 Sidney Rd
problem: Municipality is right, but the course is owned and operated by Middlesex County (listed on the county golf site) - a government/municipal facility, an excluded type.
fix: Remove, or move to the excluded/government bucket.

claim: Franchise and chain entries: Signarama Piscataway, Sir Speedy Piscataway, SpeedPro Piscataway, The Goddard School, The Learning Experience, KinderCare, Abbey Carpet Factory Outlets
problem: Seven entries are national franchise/chain brands, an excluded type. The mapper flagged them but kept them in the main list, so they still sit in the deliverable as if eligible.
fix: Move all seven to an excluded/chain bucket (or a separate 'franchisee-owned, confirm before outreach' file) so the triage team does not spend time on them.

claim: An-Noor Academy and Timothy Christian School
problem: Both are K-12 private schools - the 'schools' exclusion. Keeping them alongside tutoring and childcare providers blurs the group D scope.
fix: Remove or move to the excluded bucket unless the zone brief explicitly includes K-12 schools.

claim: River Road Fire Company Banquet Hall, 102 Netherwood Ave
problem: Address and activity are correct, but the hall is the rental facility of a volunteer fire company (civic/non-profit, modest flat-rate pricing, and its own page bars profit-making events). That is a quasi-civic lead rather than an SMB prospect.
fix: Flag as civic/quasi-government and let the triage team decide; consider excluding.

problem: The website gives no street address at all - it advertises in-person training in the Piscataway/New Brunswick area. The Piscataway assignment therefore rests on a service area, not a facility.
fix: Mark as 'service area only - no fixed Piscataway address' or drop until an address is confirmed.

claim: Thirteen entries with address 'Unknown' (Harmony Jewelers, Roxy's Store, My Framing Store, Central Jersey Abaya and Dresses, Paws & Bubbles, P.A.W.S. University, Pantagis Renaissance, A1 STEM Academy, NexGen Packaging, Continental Precision, Quality Sheet Metal and Welding, Weston Machine Co, Agilex Fragrances)
problem: No street address was captured, so zone membership and eligibility cannot be checked. One of them (Pantagis) proved to be in another town and closed, and A1 STEM Academy and NexGen Packaging are flagged by the mapper as possibly service-area-only.
fix: Require an address before these go to triage; drop any that cannot be pinned to Piscataway.

problem: The cited source (yoursignco.com) confirms the shop is based in Piscataway but never prints a street address on the pages I opened, so the street number is unsupported by the citation given.
fix: Cite the page that actually shows the address (contact/service-area page) or mark the address unverified.

problem: Address and phone check out on the state child-care provider record, but the state listing shows ages 1-4, licensed capacity 120 - not 0-13.

claim: Sixty-plus 'one directory only' entries with no website and phone 'Unknown'
problem: Roughly half the list (most NJ Business Directory manufacturers/wholesalers) rests on a single directory that carries only name, category and address, and several entries duplicate each other (Design & Molding Svc vs Montrose Molders at 25 Howard St; Helm US Chemical vs Helm New York at 1110 Centennial Ave; National Manufacturing vs S.S. White Aerospace at 151 Old New Brunswick Rd; PALS vs UniQ Prep at 1629 Stelton Rd).
fix: Deduplicate before triage and run a second source (state registry or the company's own site) on each before outreach.

claim: Food-sector entries: Snack Innovations Inc, Thomas Foods Inc, Ferraro Foods of New Jersey, Douglas Sales/Price Mark, Trans-Packers Services Corp
problem: These are food manufacturers/wholesalers rather than restaurants, so they probably survive the 'food' exclusion - but the list never states that distinction, so a reviewer applying the exclusion literally would strike five or more entries.
fix: Add a note to the caveats that the food exclusion was applied to food service only, not to food manufacturing/wholesale.
